description: This file defines a dataclass 'Settings' for managing application configuration related to PostgreSQL database connection parameters, including methods to generate an async database URL and a function to load settings from environment variables.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Immutable dataclass that encapsulates database configuration parameters and provides a method to generate a database connection URL.

methods.name: str sqlalchemy_async_database_url(self)
methods.description: Constructs the asynchronous SQLAlchemy database URL based on provided environment variables or a direct URL.

methods.name: Settings get_settings()
methods.description: Loads and returns a Settings instance populated with environment variables.
